CFML Language Reference: Functions

ArrayClear

Empties an array. The array itself still exists (and keeps its number of dimensions), it just has no elements any more.

Category

Array functions

Syntax

ArrayClear(array)

Parameters

array
The array to empty.

Returns

TRUE (prints as YES).

Usage

After ArrayClear, ArrayLen returns 0 and ArrayIsEmpty returns TRUE. To remove a single element, use ArrayDeleteAt.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Tasks = ListToArray("Patch Y2K bug,Back up server,Order pizza")>
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Before: #ArrayLen(Tasks)# tasks (#ArrayToList(Tasks, "; ")#)</P>
<CFSET Temp = ArrayClear(Tasks)>
<P>After ArrayClear: #ArrayLen(Tasks)# tasks.
ArrayIsEmpty says <B>#ArrayIsEmpty(Tasks)#</B>.</P>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

ArrayDeleteAt, ArrayIsEmpty, ArrayLen, StructClear
